title: Route checks run the lookup eval questions end to end
goal: A test named route_eval_end_to_end runs every lookup-eval question through kbfacts.pack, kb_hook.py --test and kb_ask.plan with split_prompt/web_prompt (no model) and asserts per route that the hook lets a routed pack through, no prompt carries 'kb has: -' or 'kb lacks: -' as a part, every part of a several-part question reaches the reader or the researcher, and a split pack never carries the none sentence; kb/_self/backlog.md's definition of done asks a check over real inputs besides planted ones. Failure it answers: SP-aikswrrl's item checks passed on worker-chosen planted packs while the review found four route defects (BG-ed6ci57t, BG-zrzme2li, BG-ou6nahcx, BG-bxkqdtk6).
